plugins.name: Pure Control
plugins.blurb: LLM assistant that drives Ableton Live by chat.

detail.tagline: An AI assistant that lives inside Ableton Live — tell it what you want, and it drives your session.
detail.description: Pure Control puts a producer-grade AI assistant directly in your Ableton Live session. Type what you want — "build me a techno session at 128", "sidechain the bass to the kick", "warm up the master" — and it performs the moves on real devices through a native Live bridge: loading instruments, shaping sounds, building full arrangements. It runs on your Pure BPM Coinz balance, so there are no API keys to manage.
highlights: One-prompt session builder — drums, bass, lead hooks and arrangement, varied every time
Mix & mastering moves applied to your actual set — curated device chains, gain staging, sidechain
Chat mode for production questions, Work mode for hands-on control
requirements: Installs the Live remote script for you

plugins.name: Pure AI
plugins.blurb: Generate full tracks right inside your DAW.

detail.tagline: Generate full tracks without leaving your DAW, then drag them straight onto your timeline.
detail.description: Pure AI is a music generator inside your DAW. Describe a track, pick an engine (MusicGPT, Mureka or MiniMax), write your own lyrics, let AI write them, or go instrumental, then set a voice and tempo and generate. Audition and scrub each take, then drag it straight onto a track as WAV or MP3. Every take is saved in your Library on your machine. Generation runs on your Coinz balance.
highlights: Three engines: MusicGPT, Mureka and MiniMax, with the price shown before you generate
Write your own lyrics, let AI write them, or go instrumental
Audition, scrub and drag takes straight onto your timeline as WAV or MP3
Every take saved locally in your Library, even if you close the plugin mid-run

plugins.name: Pure Samples
plugins.blurb: Generate samples from text, or search the Pure BPM marketplace — all drag-ready.

detail.tagline: Type a sound and generate it, or search our marketplace — hi-fi one-shots and loops, drag-ready.
detail.description: Pure Samples is a text-to-sample generator that lives in your DAW. Describe the sound — "dusty vinyl kick", "metallic riser, 4 bars", "wet clap with tape saturation" — and it renders a high-fidelity, drag-ready sample. Or flip to the Sample Bank tab and search the Pure BPM marketplace: type keywords, audition the matches, and drop a published sample straight into your tray. Every take lands in your sample tray: audition, re-roll, set length and looping, then drag it onto a track. Your tray restores with the plugin, and samples are stored locally — they're yours. Generations and marketplace purchases run on your Coinz balance.
highlights: Hi-fi 44.1 kHz stereo output — drum hits, FX, textures, risers
Search the Pure BPM sample marketplace and drop published samples straight into your tray
Length & loop controls, with a sample tray that restores between sessions
Drag straight to any Ableton track — samples stored locally, yours to keep
